prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Account pet sync reassurance note on sign in: Displays a clear account synchronization hint below sign-in options clarifying that signing in restores and preserves existing desktop pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in automatically syncs and restores your saved pets across devices."}}
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop pet launch wait timer countdown: Shows a live timer component and estimated desktop launch time on the waiting screen while the companion initializes.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "text": "Your pet is landing on your desktop in under 60 seconds", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Interactive desktop companion controls introduction screen: Inserts a dedicated setup completion screen right before finishing onboarding that details desktop pet control shortcuts, hiding options, and interaction methods.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_controls", "home_intro"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Your pet is ready for your desktop!", "body": "Use top-corner controls or right-click your pet to interact, hide, or summon them anytime."}}
3: [adoption, redesign] Companion selection grid layout redesign: Redesigns the friend picking screen into a grid layout showcasing pet personalities and visual previews clearly.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Pick your perfect desktop companion", "body": "Select a personality style that fits your daily desktop workflow."}}
4: [choose_path, copy] Personality-focused journey path headline: Updates the path choice headline and text to emphasize tailored pet companion personalities.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "What kind of personality fits your desktop workspace?", "body": "Choose between a calm productivity assistant or a playful virtual mascot."}}
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop controls onboarding sub-flow: Adds a interactive checklist component on the home intro screen guiding users through hiding, showing, and chatting with their pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Desktop Quick Tips: 1. Double click to chat 2. Drag to move 3. Right-click to hide", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [choose_path, hint] Companion selection duration hint: Adds a duration hint to path selection screen letting users know path setup takes less than 1 minute.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Path setup takes under 1 minute. You can switch companions anytime."}}
7: [adoption, redesign] Adoption certificate milestone stage redesign: Redesigns the adoption certificate step into a spotlight layout highlighting the official pet adoption name and badge.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Official Desktop Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your companion is officially registered to your desktop workspace."}}
8: [adoption, hint] Photo companion compatibility guidance hint: Adds a clear hint on photo upload detailing quick photo requirements to prevent generation glitches.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload a clear, well-lit photo of your pet for best custom pet generation."}}
9: [home, wait_info] Desktop companion activation progress ticker: Adds an estimated activation time countdown and live progress component to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "text": "Initializing pet animations and desktop physics...", "style": "emphasis"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a clear account synchronization hint on sign in without violating any rules.
Countdown timer on the waiting screen represents a real wait during pet creation.
Adds a new controls introduction screen inside onboarding, which is permitted.
Redesigns companion selection grid while preserving the pet choosing functionality.
Choose path screen fails to offer both adopting and making your own pet.
Adds a quick tips checklist component to the home intro screen within onboarding.
Adds a duration hint to path selection without altering required options or functionality.
Redesigns certificate layout while preserving the official adoption certificate functionality.
Adds clear guidance hint for photo selection on the photo upload step.
Displays progress information on the waiting screen while pet initializes.
